nodes.label: Docker Compose Service Topology
nodes.rationale: Services are ordered: database -> backend-db-migrate (alembic) -> backend -> tool-member-sync. This ensures migrations run before the API starts, and the sync tool only runs on demand via Docker profile 'sync', keeping scraping decoupled from the main stack.

nodes.label: Upsert-based Member Sync Pattern
nodes.rationale: Member sync uses upsert (not insert+update) to handle idempotent member data ingestion from the scraper tool. This allows repeated sync runs without duplicates, relying on jkt48_id unique constraint in the DB.

nodes.label: Next.js Remote Image Pattern for jkt48.com
nodes.rationale: next.config.ts whitelists jkt48.com as a remote image host so Next.js Image optimization works for member profile photos fetched from the official JKT48 website.
